_about: Studio Gloss v14 (trained 5 Oct 2026 from 5 Top-100 refs: Mohmd.Visuals r11 (Ahmed's #1), afterpranav r5/r6/r10, EDIT_MADNESS r12; ~/reels/style-train/studio-gloss). A premium explainer look: the speaker in natural, slightly bright colour, small mixed-size captions with one bold italic key word in a cool accent, and bright full-screen 'studio' cards (white to soft cyan gradient) that carry a small dark lead line, a big accent key word and one central prop object. Photo cards with a label tag pop over the speaker; occasional light-leak flash. Clean, airy, high-key: the opposite of a moody grade.

brand._paperNote: scene grounds render at background-size 220%, so only the first ~46% of a gradient is visible: put every stop inside 0-46%

director.style: Studio Gloss: a premium, airy explainer. The speaker (natural colour, bright) carries it; every 2-4 s the reel cuts to a bright STUDIO CARD (white to soft cyan gradient) that turns the line into a tiny poster: small dark lead words at the top third, ONE big key word in the accent, and one prop object in the middle. Typography stays small and tidy; the key word is the only loud thing.
director.captions: captions.heroes: one hero per phrase (the word that carries the line, never a filler like 'actually', 'really', 'so'). Small words are sans, the hero is bold italic in the accent. Mixed case as spoken.
director.cards: {type:scene, kind:stack, bg:'paper', at, to, lead: small words spoken before the key, key: ONE word (or two short) spoken as the punch, keyColor: '#14181F' (dark ink, like r11's card type; variants set their own accent), tail: optional small words after, icon: engraving prop (brain, coins, hourglass, lightbulb, chart, laptop, rocket, target, trophy, moneybag, phone, robot, gears, team...), iconSize: 380-460}. 0.9-2.2 s, 30-45% of the runtime, never two cards back to back without the speaker between. Every word on a card must be spoken while it is up.
director.photocards: {type:popcard, src: assets/stock/<pick>.jpg, label: ONE spoken word (the emotion / the thing), at, to} over the speaker for concrete nouns (a person, a feeling, a place). 0.8-1.6 s. Use stock_fetch.py (public domain / CC0) for the photo.
director.flash: {type:leak} 0.35-0.45 s at most once per 15 s, on a section change.
director.rhythm: Measured: picture changes every ~3 s (20/min; r11 alone every 1.7 s). Use 3-4 cards + 1 photo card per 20 s, punches are fine between. Open on the speaker or on a card with the hook word. Leave 0.6-1 s on the speaker after each card. Avoid clumped cuts: start a card ON a take cut (so the jump cut and the card-in are one change), and if the last line gets a card let it run to the very end (no outro, no 1-frame return to the speaker).
director.master: Style master {lufs -14, ratio 1.5, threshold -20, lra 9} is applied by scripts/render.sh (ratio 3 squeezed LRA to 1.1, ratio 2 gave 1.3; refs sit at 2.1).
